_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Air cast in the owner-approved Powder tone (ground.json). [MM-story_mwohmiyq_2u]

ground.why: They trade engine parts for Ines Roth's powder.

lines.start: Groundling. I patch what fighting breaks. Go on.
lines.win: Low wear, low parts cost. Logged it.
lines.lose: Twelve airframes gone. Logged as a loss.

secrets.text: They want Dawnpollen. It scrubs the carbon out of a seized engine.
secrets.line: Dawnpollen. Best engine cleaner on Florael. Don't tell the bees.

secrets.text: They hear metal fatigue before it cracks, like a held breath.
secrets.line: That wing's holding its breath. Ground it.

secrets.text: They'll share spare parts with anyone who lands what they fly.
secrets.line: Bring the birds back whole, and the spares are yours.

mission.task: Win a Florael map without losing a structure.

secrets.text: They hate Wing-Commander Kowalski, who logs pilots as spare parts.
secrets.line: Kowalski calls pilots consumables. I fix consumables.

secrets.text: They love Quartermaster Ines Roth of the Powder. The gaskets are an excuse.
secrets.line: Gaskets for powder. And letters. Mostly letters.

secrets.text: A crashed courier plane full of spares, hidden in the petal fields.
secrets.line: There's a wreck in the petal fields. Nobody logged it.

mission.task: Recover the wreck from the petal fields on Florael map 1.

secrets.text: They want a workshop where nobody asks whose wing it is.
secrets.line: One day, a shop. No flags on the door.

secrets.text: Anything they bolt together flies once more than it should.
secrets.line: My patches fly once past ruin. Only once.

mission.task: Deliver 10 Petal Silk for wing patches.

secrets.text: Their trade with Ines put Air engine parts inside Powder guns.
secrets.line: My parts are in Powder guns now. I checked.

space.why: Ezra Lin is his rival, and his only friend.

lines.start: Take the sky. It's got my family's name on it.
lines.lose: Get up, groundling. You don't get to quit.

secrets.text: He feels a storm front in his teeth a day early.
secrets.line: My teeth ache. Storm tomorrow. Fly today.

secrets.text: Planes fly faster for him when nobody is watching.
secrets.line: Planes go faster when nobody's looking. True story.

mission.task: Win a Florael map in under ten minutes.

secrets.text: He loves Ezra "Comet" Lin of the Space, and calls it a rivalry.
secrets.line: Ezra Lin's my rival. Shut up. Rival.

secrets.text: He hates the Minami name, painted on every plane he's given.
secrets.line: Every plane they give me has our name on it.

secrets.text: He wants Skyhoney. The ground crew paints over crests for honey.
secrets.line: Skyhoney. The crew paints over crests for honey.

secrets.text: He'll share his stunt routes with a commander who wins on their own.
secrets.line: Win without help, and I'll show you my tricks.

mission.task: Win a Florael map without taking a bonus pick.

secrets.text: He wants to win one race under a made-up name.
secrets.line: One race. Fake name. Win it clean.

secrets.text: His grandfather's medal, thrown off a cliff. He secretly wants it back.
secrets.line: I threw Grandpa's medal off a cliff. I want it back.

mission.task: Find the medal under the cliffs on Florael map 2.

secrets.text: His father died a legend, and Kaito never told him he hated it.
secrets.line: Dad died a legend. I never told him I hated that.

ground.why: She loves Otto von Halbrecht, a Powder captain.

lines.start: I don't hate you. I just want one clear sky.
lines.win: Fewer of us died today. That's my win.
lines.lose: Grounded. Somebody's landing strip stays empty tonight.

secrets.text: She loves Captain Otto von Halbrecht of the Powder, across the war line.
secrets.line: If you meet Captain Otto, tell him I'm still flying.

secrets.text: Otto shot down her wingman, Ken Sato, before either knew the other's name.
secrets.line: Otto killed my wingman. I love him anyway. Both true.

secrets.text: She wants a Choir Lily. It sings while someone you love is safe.
secrets.line: A Choir Lily sings while he's safe. I need one.

secrets.text: She wants one clear sky, and a landing strip on his side.
secrets.line: One clear sky. One landing, on his side.

secrets.text: She'll share the quiet flight lanes with anyone who spares downed pilots.
secrets.line: Spare the downed pilots, and I'll show you the quiet lanes.

mission.task: Win Florael map 3 at three stars.

secrets.text: She hates General Kord Stahl, who keeps the war fed.
secrets.line: Stahl feeds the war. Somebody has to starve it.

secrets.text: She hears Otto's heartbeat on her radio. Nobody else can.
secrets.line: His heartbeat's on my radio again. Nobody else hears it.

secrets.text: Otto's letters, dropped from his trench, hidden in a hollow tree on the front.
secrets.line: His letters are in a hollow tree. Bring them, please.

mission.task: Recover the letters from the hollow tree on Florael map 3.

secrets.text: Anyone who flies her wing lands safely, once.
secrets.line: Fly my wing once, and you'll land. Promise.

mission.task: Bring every flier home: win a Florael map without losing an air unit.

space.why: He flew escort for Commander Idris Vale.

lines.start: I've got your six. Earn it.
lines.win: Textbook. Not one wingman went down.
lines.lose: I'll fly the missing-man for you, groundling.

secrets.text: He'll teach his formation to a commander who loses nobody.
secrets.line: Lose nobody, and I'll teach you the formation.

mission.task: Win two Florael maps in a row.

secrets.text: He wants Petal Silk, for the missing-man banners.
secrets.line: Petal Silk. I've run out of missing-man banners.

secrets.text: He hates the Powder captain who shot down his brother Ken. He doesn't know it was Otto.
secrets.line: Some Powder captain killed my brother. I'll find him.

secrets.text: Nobody flying in his formation dies alone.
secrets.line: In my formation, nobody dies alone. Ever.

mission.task: Hold formation: win a Florael map without losing a tower.

secrets.text: He feels an empty slot in the sky before a pilot falls.
secrets.line: There's a gap in the sky today. Watch your six.

secrets.text: He loves Rei "Skylark" Tanaka, his brother's wingmate. She loves someone else.
secrets.line: Rei flew with my brother. I'd fly for her.

secrets.text: His brother's flight jacket, still in the wreck on the ridge.
secrets.line: Ken's jacket is still in the wreck. Bring it home.

mission.task: Recover the jacket from the ridge wreck on Florael map 4.

secrets.text: He wants to retire as the ace who never lost a wingman. It's already too late.
secrets.line: Never lost a wingman, they'll write. It's wrong.

secrets.text: Ken died because Jun broke formation to chase a kill.
secrets.line: I broke formation for a kill. Ken paid for it.

artillery.why: Chaplain Ruth Bellamy buries her fallen kids.

lines.start: Wheels up, little one. Everyone comes home to me.
lines.win: Not a feather bent. Good child.
lines.lose: Sleep now, groundling. I'll fold your wings myself.

secrets.text: She wants Dawnpollen, for the tea every pilot drinks before takeoff.
secrets.line: Dawnpollen, please. My kids won't fly without their tea.

secrets.text: She loves Jun Sato like a son. He was her first student.
secrets.line: Jun was my first. He still flies too close.

secrets.text: She'll share her rescue roster with anyone who brings a downed pilot home.
secrets.line: Bring my lost ones home, and the dawn is yours.

mission.task: Recover the downed pilot on Florael map 5.

secrets.text: She feels each of her kids land, like a door closing softly.
secrets.line: Thirty-one landed today. One is still out.

secrets.text: She hates Sky-Marshal Kurogane, who spends pilots to keep the sky tidy.
secrets.line: Reiko spends my kids to keep her sky neat.

secrets.text: She wants to rest the day the last kid comes home. It never comes.
secrets.line: The day the last one lands, I'll rest.

secrets.text: Her call sign reaches any lost pilot, wherever they fell.
secrets.line: Call 'Dawnwing' and I'll hear it. Anywhere.

mission.task: Win a Florael map without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: The Nightingale were her kids. She sent them up on Kurogane's order.
secrets.line: The Nightingale were my kids. I let them go up.

secrets.text: The squadron's founding logbook, every name she ever flew with, hidden in the old hangar.
secrets.line: Every name I've flown with is in one logbook.

mission.task: Recover the logbook from the old hangar on Florael map 5.

artillery.why: Flak took his first plane, and his patience.

lines.win: Ha! Too quick for me. For now.
lines.lose: Down you go. I love this part.

secrets.text: The shortcut through the cloud wall runs straight into the flak lines.
secrets.line: The shortcut? Straight into the flak. Ha!

lie.text: He'll share his shortcut through the cloud wall if you race him.
lie.line: Race me through the cloud wall. I'll show you the shortcut.

mission.task: Race him: win a Florael map in under ten minutes.

secrets.text: He wants Helium-3. It makes engines scream. Rax Dune won't sell him any.
secrets.line: Helium-3. Makes the engine scream. I love screaming.

secrets.text: He's never been caught. The sky moves aside for him.
secrets.line: The sky gets out of my way. Always has.

mission.task: Destroy 50 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: He hates Ace Jun Sato, who flies clean and makes it look easy.
secrets.line: Halo flies clean. I'd love to dirty him up.

secrets.text: The canyon jet is rigged to blow. He wants to watch.
secrets.line: Rigged, obviously. I wanted to watch.

lie.text: He says he stashed a stolen jet in the canyon, free to whoever finds it.
lie.line: Stolen jet in the canyon. Finders keepers.

mission.task: Search the canyon on Florael map 6.

secrets.text: He can taste fear in the exhaust of the plane ahead.
secrets.line: Smell that? You're scared. Tastes like fuel.

secrets.text: He loves Privateer Rax Dune, the only thing faster than him. He'd shoot him down for fun.
secrets.line: Rax is faster than me. I'll fix that.

secrets.text: He wants someone to finally outfly him. Then he wants to kill them.
secrets.line: Someday someone outflies me. Then I kill them.

secrets.text: He froze on a run once. His little sister flew it instead, and didn't come back.
secrets.line: I froze once. My sister flew instead. Didn't come back.

ground.why: She has beaten Kord Stahl twice. Powder no longer frightens her.

lines.start: Look up, groundling, and know your place.
lines.lose: The sky drops the arrogant. You climbed for this.

secrets.text: She despises General Kord Stahl, who writes to her after every defeat.
secrets.line: Stahl writes me after each loss. I burn them.

secrets.text: She wants Dune Quartz, for the lenses of her command scopes.
secrets.line: Dune Quartz. My scopes must see everything.

secrets.text: She'll lend her interceptors to a commander who keeps perfect order.
secrets.line: Keep perfect order, and my interceptors fly for you.

mission.task: Win Florael map 7 at three stars.

secrets.text: Within sight of her flagship, no plane flies out of formation.
secrets.line: Under my flagship, nothing flies crooked.

mission.task: Destroy every flier in a wave before it reaches the base.

secrets.text: She wants a sky where only she flies.
secrets.line: A sky with one pilot. Me.

lie.text: She says she wants only balance in the heavens.

secrets.text: She feels the sky tilt when anyone breaks rank, like a crooked picture.
secrets.line: Someone broke rank. The sky is crooked.

secrets.text: She loves Hikari Aoi, her old wingmate, who chose children over order.
secrets.line: Hikari flew my wing once. She chose wrong.

secrets.text: Her first wings, from before she was perfect, locked in her flagship.
secrets.line: My first wings are in the flagship. Earn a look.

mission.task: Board the flagship: win Florael map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: She sent the squadron that became the Nightingale on a run with no return.
secrets.line: I sent the Nightingale up. I knew. I sent them.

artillery.why: Colonel Hargreave shares their doctrine: end it fast.

lines.start: Contest my sky, and they die slower below.
lines.win: Decisive. The merciful war is the short one.
lines.lose: You dragged it out. That's the atrocity.

secrets.text: The cover is a bombing run. It flattens both sides to finish sooner.
secrets.line: Cover? I bomb everything. It ends sooner.

lie.text: They offer air cover to any commander who ends a map fast.
lie.line: End it fast, and my wings cover you.

mission.task: Win a Florael map in under eight minutes.

secrets.text: They want Mirage Oil, for fire that ends a siege in an hour.
secrets.line: Mirage Oil. One hour of fire beats a year of siege.

secrets.text: They hate Squadron-Mother Hikari, whose rescues drag every war out.
secrets.line: Hikari saves pilots. Each rescue costs a week of war.

secrets.text: Any battle they watch ends before nightfall, one way or another.
secrets.line: If I'm watching, it's over by dark.

mission.task: Win a Florael map without any wave reaching the base.

secrets.text: They feel the minute a war turns, like a cold coin in the palm.
secrets.line: The war turned an hour ago. You missed it.

secrets.text: They love Sky-Marshal Kurogane, who uses them like a good knife.
secrets.line: Kurogane points, I cut. Call it love.

secrets.text: They want to end every war personally, and be thanked for it.
secrets.line: End every war myself. Then be thanked.

secrets.text: A list of the cities they burned to shorten wars, and the lives they claim it saved.
secrets.line: My list of mercies. Cities, and the lives they saved.

mission.task: Recover the list from the bunker on Florael map 8.

secrets.text: Their first short war was fought against their own home town.
secrets.line: My first quick war was my own town.

arcane.why: Arcane priests keep trying to lay it to rest.

lines.start: We already fell. Come up. Go quiet.
lines.win: You climbed through us. Nothing touched you.
lines.lose: Down. Quiet. We were always going to meet.

secrets.text: It hears every radio left on in a crash, still hissing.
secrets.line: Static, everywhere. All the radios nobody switched off.

secrets.text: Its lights lead up into the ceiling, where it is quiet forever.
secrets.line: Up. Always up. Nobody follows us back down.

lie.text: It offers to guide your fliers through the storm ceiling.
lie.line: Follow our lights through the ceiling. We know the way.

mission.task: Win Florael map 9 without losing a flier.

secrets.text: It wants a Choir Lily, so the dead can hear a song again.
secrets.line: Bring a Choir Lily. We forgot what singing was.

secrets.text: Fliers it marks can't be heard by radar, or by the living.
secrets.line: We can make you silent. Like us.

mission.task: Destroy 40 fliers on one Florael map.

secrets.text: It hates Sky-Marshal Kurogane, who sent the squadron up to die.
secrets.line: Kurogane sent us. Bring her up. We'll wait.

secrets.text: It still loves Squadron-Mother Hikari, and wants her up here with them.
secrets.line: Mother never came for us. We'll come for her.

lie.text: It says it loves nothing. The dead don't.
lie.line: Love? We left that on the runway.

secrets.text: The wrecks hold only the pilots. They want to be found.
secrets.line: No gold. Only us. Please find us.

lie.text: It says the squadron's wrecks hold gold, for anyone brave enough.
lie.line: Our wrecks are full of gold. Come look.

mission.task: Find the squadron wrecks on Florael map 9.

secrets.text: It wants the war unwritten: no squadron, no legend, no ghosts.
secrets.line: Unwrite the war. Then we can stop.

secrets.text: They were children. They went up because Mother said they'd come home.
secrets.line: Mother said we'd come home. We believed her.

secondary.name: Quartermaster Ines Roth
secondary.line: Tell Sora the powder's dry. And nothing else.

secondary.name: Cadet-Prodigy Ezra "Comet" Lin
secondary.line: Kaito's flying? Tell him I'm faster. He'll know.

secondary.name: Captain Otto von Halbrecht
secondary.line: Is Skylark up there? Tell her I'm still standing.

secondary.name: Commander Idris Vale
secondary.line: Halo's on escort? Then nobody gets left behind.

secondary.name: Chaplain-Gunner Ruth Bellamy
secondary.line: Hikari writes after every crash. I always answer.

secondary.name: Privateer Rax Dune
secondary.line: Viper wants a race? Tell him I already won.

secondary.name: General Kord Stahl
secondary.line: Kurogane. I wrote you another letter. Read this one.

secondary.name: Colonel Hargreave
secondary.line: Kowalski wants it short. My guns agree.

secondary.name: The Signal
secondary.line: We hear them too. Past the ceiling. Hissing.
